title: Zesty Indulgent Middle Eastern Wheat Harees
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish with a twist, featuring crispy bacon lardon and a jammy, fluffy wheat harees, perfect for a special occasion, this egg-free friendly recipe is a delight to the senses.
instructions: Rinse the wheat berries and soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the wheat berries, then transfer them to a large pot with the chicken broth, olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or until the wheat is tender.
While the wheat is cooking, cook the bacon lardon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
Once the wheat is cooked, use a fork to fluff it up and break it down into a jammy consistency.
Stir in the cooked bacon lardon and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the harees hot, garnished with additional paprika if desired.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
